title: 第1章 “生”的执念
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 青藤市，火化殡仪馆。夕阳落山，最后一点微光消逝天际。黑暗迅速蔓延，殡仪馆亮着昏黄的灯光。一楼大厅里，许牧掏出手机看了眼时间，自言自语道：“8点40，夜里值班第一件事，检查停尸房气温，要是让‘客人’化了，自已估计要被辞退。”刚找到的兼职，事少钱多，一晚1600，那得尽职尽责啊。深吸了口气，许牧拿上手电筒和值班武器，转身走向通往停尸房的走廊。走廊天花板上每隔几米就挂着一顶吊灯，外表老旧，灯光泛黄，随着穿堂风轻微摇晃。一丝阴风吹过后颈，许牧下意识地紧了紧外套，脚步没停。活了两辈子，许牧还是第一次干这种工作，没办法，谁让他现在兜比脸干净呢。吱呀！门把手转动，他推开停尸房的门，一股阴寒白气从门缝渗出。许牧先往里面看了一圈，才快速走向最里面的温度调节器。哪个大傻逼设计的，离门口这么远……他心里边骂边查看温度。确定温度足以将‘客人’们冻得梆硬，刘德华来了想解冻都难，他没有丝毫停留，转身就朝门口走去。过程中，许牧眼角余光无意瞥到路过的一个‘床位’，上面的顾客盖着绿色遮尸布，腹部位置凸了起来，圆鼓鼓得勾勒出半球形。这是……孕妇？一尸两命啊，有点可怜……许牧当即皱起眉头，心里不由感叹。摇了摇头，继续往前走。突然，即将路过她的许牧听见‘呼啦’一声！那是遮尸布被掀起的声音！紧接着，他感到左手腕被什么东西死死钳住！随即传来冰凉的触感。许牧顿住脚步，扭头看去，瞳孔悚然一缩！只见那具怀孕的女尸在不足他三十厘米的位置，右手紧紧地攥住他的左手腕，直挺挺地坐了起来！这一刻，许牧只觉一阵寒意流遍全身，最后从脊背直冲天灵盖，让他头皮发麻，寒毛根根竖起，鸡皮疙瘩起了一层又一层。精神状态瞬间跌至崩溃边缘，但他紧咬牙关，竭力忍住想要喊叫的冲动，硬生生地靠意志把那股寒意压了下去。女尸僵硬地扭过脖子，看向许牧，双眼无神，瞳孔涣散，声音却意外的轻柔：“老公，我们的宝宝出生了吗？你说过，宝宝出生，你娶我。”？许牧刚脱离极度惊悚的状态，听到这句话，又陷入了懵逼状态。他右手悄悄摸向腰间的武器，那是一把类似廓尔喀的反曲刀。手放在刀柄上未动，他警惕着女尸的动作。眼前的女尸不知是人是鬼还是其他东西，既然现在可以对话，那就先顺着她来……许牧念头急转，当即做出决断。“嗯……娶。但，宝宝还没出生。”许牧勉强挤出一个‘温柔’的笑容，指着女尸圆滚滚的肚子道。不知为何，这句话好像对女尸刺激很大，她松开抓住许牧的手，哗啦一把扯掉身上的遮尸布，独属于死人的苍白皮肤瞬间映入眼帘。她低着脑袋，抚摸着自已的孕肚，略带疯癫地喃喃道：“没生下来……为什么还没有生下来！”忽然，她抬头看向许牧，半是慌张半是急切地恳求：“医生，快，快给我接生，我老公还在等我生下宝宝。”许牧一怔，脑筋飞快运转，随即露出一个礼貌的微笑道：“好……好的，请躺好。”他似乎已经适应了这个荒诞的场景，完全掌握了节奏。“女士，鉴于你情绪不是很稳定，我需要给你打上一点麻醉。”“别担心，只是一点，您也不想因为您的情绪而影响到宝宝健康吧。”“对，放松，把眼睛闭起来。”许牧一点点安抚，一步步引导。“好，就这样，深呼吸，轻微疼痛是正常的……”“要忍……住！！！”最后一个字落下，许牧双手紧握短刀，狠狠捅进女尸左胸口，并将自身的重量也压在了上面。没有尖叫，没有挣扎，甚至连轻微地晃动都没有，女尸平静地躺在停尸床上，双眼自然闭合，好像从来没有醒来过，仿佛刚才都是一场幻觉。十几秒后，确认女尸真的没有任何反应后，许牧收了力道，注视着她的眼睛，重新站直身体，长长呼出一口气。然而，就当许牧正要放松下来时，那双眼睛骤然睁开，死死盯着他，声音里带着狂躁爆发前的克制：“医生，怎么还不开始！？你是不是不想给我接生！！”？？？许牧脸上掠过一分惊吓，两分疑惑，三分意外，四分窘迫错愕。画面定格两秒后。他尴尬又不失礼貌地笑笑，拔出女尸胸口插着的弯刀，语气安抚道：“这就开始，别急，想想你的孩子。”插心脏都不死，似乎只能把戏演下去了……许牧心一横，右手刀光一闪。女尸圆滚的肚皮被一分为二，黑红的粘稠血浆如挤压爆珠般溅射出来，许牧连忙伸手扯下旁边‘哥们’的遮尸布挡在身前。还好带着刀来的，要是空手就有点麻烦，毕竟不知道尸体能不能顺产。‘血雨’过后，拿开遮挡物，他看见了女尸肚子里面的一滩婴儿。一滩婴儿？许牧揉了下眼睛，才确定没有看错，女尸肚子里装的，是一滩烂肉，布满大小孔洞的肉泥还往外淌着粘稠液体，发出阵阵恶臭。他用遮尸布隔着手掌，屏息皱眉，将它托举到女尸眼前，颇有种昧着良心道：“女士，恭喜您，孩子很健康。”女尸看着那滩烂肉泥，伸手接过，抱在怀里，有那么一瞬间，许牧好像真的从她那毫无活人气息的脸上看到了一丝母爱涌现。“医生，谢谢你，你看我的孩子，多好看啊，很像他的爸爸。”嗯……嗯？像他爸爸，难道他爸爸就长这样？不过许牧很快就不纠结了，女尸嘴里的话当不得真，刚才自已还又是老公，又是医生呢。女尸没再说一句话，抱着她的‘孩子’，慢慢地躺了下去，很长时间毫无动静。期间许牧试着叫她，或轻轻戳她，但都没有一点反应，看来这次是真的死了。费了这么大劲儿，搞了半天，就是为了诞下一滩烂肉？许牧左右想不通，但他从不是内耗的人，想不通就先不想了，现在，还有更重要的事情需要关注。眼里露出欣喜的光采，许牧意念一动，看见了存在于脑海内的面板。【检测到精神类超凡灵性，吸收成功，3/3】【已达到超凡灵性容纳总上限】【已解锁“精神序列”初始节点，距离解锁“精神序列”二节点还需6点精神类超凡灵性】【精神序列初始节点生效：你的头脑更加清醒，不易陷入昏迷、蛊惑、幻觉当中，并更容易从这些状态中清醒过来；你对周围的危险有一定的预感；你获得主动超凡能力‘执念之触’】【执念之触：以手为介，触碰高智慧生物，激发其内心最深执念，期间受术者不易死亡！可能会改变其细胞结构、基因结构、生命形式，也可能导致精神紊乱、认知错位，直到执念达成或者放下执念】许牧顿时感觉自已的大脑神情气爽，连思维也变快了一些。仔细感受了十几秒，许牧从这种状态中抽离，眼底闪过一丝了然。他是穿越者，这系统伴随他22年，今日撞上超凡事件，才算真正激活。只是系统还有一条规则，让他略感无奈。超凡灵性上限需靠“世界观测讨论度”提升，而这个世界，如同被外界观测的番剧，只有靠近核心人物，也就是主角，获得外界观众关注，才能积攒讨论度。谁是主角？系统没有标注。只能以后慢慢找了。暗骂一句系统后，许牧的关注点转移到了刚获得的能力“执念之触”上。作为本世界土生土长的穿越者，他之前没少听关于超凡者、序列者的传闻。普通人只把这些奇闻轶事当成饭后闲谈，没人当真，但许牧知道那些传闻或许都不是假的，至少超凡者是存在的。就像现在的自已一样！执念之触，原来如此……他暗暗念了一遍主动超凡能力的名称，终于弄清楚诱发女尸‘复活生子’的原因了。怪不得刚才杀不死，生完“孩子”却自已死了，原来生下孩子就是她的执念。虽然这个能力负面buff叠得令人发指，但关键时刻或许有意外的效果。怀孕的尸体不用杀，生完孩子她自已会死？许牧哑然失笑：“算了，还是先通知馆方吧。”监控全程记录，只要如实上报，自有馆方处理。啪唧……啪唧。踩着黏腻血浆走出阴冷的停尸房，许牧掏出手机，拨通了殡仪馆馆长陈丧的号码。响铃期间，他依靠脑袋清醒的超凡加持，飞快地组织语言，好让自已接下来的发言更严谨。十几秒钟，电话接通，手机里传出中年男人的声音：“小许，怎么了？”许牧嗓音深沉：“陈老板，你的殡仪馆出了点异常情况，我建议你最好亲自过来一趟。”
content_en: Ivy City, Cremation Funeral Home.The sun sets, and the last glimmer of light disappears from the sky.Darkness spread quickly, and the funeral home was dimly lit.In the lobby on the first floor, Xu Mu took out his mobile phone and looked at the time, and said to himself: "8:40, the first thing on duty at night is to check the temperature in the morgue. If the 'guest' melts, I will probably be fired." The part-time job I just found has a lot of money for less work, 1,600 a night, so I have to do my best.Taking a deep breath, Xu Mu took the flashlight and duty weapon, turned and walked towards the corridor leading to the morgue.There is a chandelier hanging every few meters on the ceiling of the corridor. It looks old, the light is yellow, and it sways slightly with the draft.A hint of cold wind blew across the back of his neck, and Xu Mu tightened his coat subconsciously without stopping.After two lifetimes, this is the first time Xu Mu has done this kind of work. He has no choice but to make his pockets cleaner than his face now.Squeak!The door handle turned and he pushed open the morgue door. A cold white air seeped out from the crack in the door.Xu Mu looked around inside first, and then quickly walked towards the innermost temperature regulator.What idiot designed it, so far away from the door... He cursed in his mind while checking the temperature.Determined that the temperature was enough to freeze the 'guests' to death, it would be difficult for Andy to thaw them when he arrived. He turned around and walked towards the door without stopping at all.During the process, Xu Mu accidentally caught a glimpse of a passing 'bed' out of the corner of his eye. The customer above was covered with a green shroud, and his abdomen was bulging, so round that it outlined a hemispherical shape.Is this... a pregnant woman?One corpse and two lives, it's a bit pitiful... Xu Mu immediately frowned and couldn't help but sigh in his heart.He shook his head and continued walking forward.Suddenly, Xu Mu, who was about to pass by her, heard a "hoo!"That was the sound of the shroud being lifted up!Immediately afterwards, he felt something tightly clamping his left wrist!Then there was a cold touch.Xu Mu paused and turned around to look, his pupils shrinking in horror!He saw the pregnant female body less than thirty centimeters away from him, holding his left wrist tightly with her right hand and sitting upright!At this moment, Xu Mu felt a chill running through his body, and finally shot up from his back to the sky, making his scalp numb, his hairs standing on end, and goosebumps rising one after another.His mental state instantly fell to the edge of collapse, but he gritted his teeth, tried his best to resist the urge to shout, and suppressed the chill with willpower.The female corpse stiffly twisted her neck and looked at Xu Mu. Her eyes were dull and her pupils were dilated, but her voice was unexpectedly soft: "Husband, has our baby been born? You said that when the baby is born, you will marry me."?Xu Mugang had just come out of the state of extreme horror, but when he heard these words, he fell into confusion again.His right hand quietly touched the weapon at his waist, which was a kukri similar to a Gurkha.His hand was still on the handle of the knife, and he was wary of the movements of the female corpse.I don't know if the female corpse in front of me is a human, a ghost or something else. Since we can talk now, let's follow her first... Xu Mu's thoughts changed quickly and he made a decision immediately."Well... get married. But the baby hasn't been born yet." Xu Mu forced out a 'gentle' smile and pointed at the round belly of the female corpse.For some reason, these words seemed to greatly stimulate the female corpse. She let go of Xu Mu's hand and tore off the shroud on her body. The pale skin belonging to the dead person instantly came into view.She lowered her head, caressed her pregnant belly, and murmured slightly crazily: "I haven't given birth...why haven't I given birth yet?" Suddenly, she looked up at Xu Mu, half panicked and half eager to plead: "Doctor, hurry up, get me here!"My husband is still waiting for me to give birth to the baby." Xu Mu was startled, his mind was racing, and then he smiled politely and said: "Okay... okay, please lie down." He seemed to have adapted to this absurd scene and completely grasped the rhythm."Ma'am, since your mood is not very stable, I need to give you a little anesthesia." "Don't worry, it's just a little. You don't want to affect the baby's health because of your mood." "Yes, relax and close your eyes." Xu Mu reassured and guided step by step."Okay, that's it, take a deep breath, slight pain is normal..." "Bear it...hold it!!!" After saying the last word, Xu Mu clenched the short knife with both hands, stabbed it hard into the left chest of the female corpse, and put his own weight on it.There was no scream, no struggle, not even a slight shaking. The female corpse lay calmly on the morgue, her eyes closed naturally, as if she had never woken up, as if it was all an illusion just now.After more than ten seconds, after confirming that the female corpse was really unresponsive, Xu Mu stopped his strength, looked into her eyes, stood up straight again, and exhaled a long breath.However, just when Xu Mu was about to relax, his eyes suddenly opened and stared at him. His voice contained the restraint before a manic explosion: "Doctor, why don't you start!? Don't you want to deliver my baby!!"???Xu Mu's face flashed with one part of fright, two parts of doubt, three parts of surprise, and four parts of embarrassment and astonishment.The screen freezes for two seconds.He smiled awkwardly but politely, pulled out the scimitar stuck in the chest of the female corpse, and said in a soothing tone: "Let's start now, don't worry, think about your child." It seemed that the only thing he could do was to continue acting... Xu Mu's heart skipped a beat, and the sword in his right hand flashed.The round belly of the female corpse was split in two, and the black and red viscous blood sputtered out like exploding beads. Xu Mu quickly reached out and pulled off the shroud of the 'buddy' next to him to block it in front of him.Fortunately, he came with a knife. It would be a bit troublesome if he was empty-handed. After all, he didn't know whether the body could be delivered normally.After the 'blood rain' passed, he removed the cover and saw a pool of babies inside the belly of the female corpse.A puddle of babies?Xu Mu rubbed his eyes before confirming that he had read correctly. The belly of the female corpse was filled with a pile of rotten meat. The flesh was full of holes and was dripping with viscous liquid, giving off a stench.He held the shroud between his palms, held his breath and frowned, held it up to the female corpse, and said with a sense of shame: "Madam, congratulations, the child is healthy." The female corpse looked at the pile of rotten flesh, reached out to take it, and held it in his arms. For a moment, Xu Mu seemed to see a trace of maternal love emerging from her face that had no trace of life."Doctor, thank you. Look at my child. He looks so good. He looks like his father." Um...huh?Like his father, does his father look like this?However, Xu Mu soon stopped worrying. The words in the female corpse's mouth could not be taken seriously. Just now, he was both her husband and a doctor.The female corpse didn't say another word. She hugged her 'child' and lay down slowly. She remained motionless for a long time.During this period, Xu Mu tried to call her or poke her gently, but there was no response at all. It seemed that she was really dead this time.After spending so much effort and doing it for a long time, just to give birth to a pile of rotten meat?Xu Mu couldn't figure it out, but he was never a person who was internally conflicted. If he couldn't figure it out, he would stop thinking about it. Now, there are more important things to pay attention to.With his eyes shining with joy, Xu Mu thought and saw the panel that existed in his mind.[Psychic extraordinary spirituality detected, absorbed successfully, 3/3] [The total upper limit of extraordinary spirituality has been reached] [The initial node of "Spiritual Sequence" has been unlocked, and 6 points of spiritual extraordinary spirituality are needed to unlock the second node of "Spiritual Sequence"] [The initial node of Spiritual Sequence takes effect: your mind is clearer, notIt is easy to fall into coma, confusion, and hallucinations, and it is easier to wake up from these states; you have a certain premonition of the dangers around you; you gain the active extraordinary ability "Touch of Obsession"] [Touch of Obsession: Use your hands as a medium to touch highly intelligent creatures to stimulate their deepest obsessions. During this period, the subject will not die easily!It may change its cell structure, genetic structure, and life form, or it may cause mental disorder and cognitive dislocation until the obsession is achieved or let go.] Xu Mu suddenly felt that his brain was refreshed, and his thinking became faster.After feeling it carefully for more than ten seconds, Xu Mu pulled away from this state, and a glimmer of understanding flashed in his eyes.He is a time traveler, and this system has been with him for 22 years. Today, it was truly activated when he encountered an extraordinary event.It's just that the system has another rule, which makes him feel a little helpless.The upper limit of extraordinary spirituality needs to be increased by "world observation and discussion degree", and this world is like a drama that is observed by the outside world. Only by getting close to the core character, that is, the protagonist, and gaining the attention of the outside audience can the discussion degree be accumulated.Who is the protagonist?The system has no label.I can only find it slowly in the future.After silently cursing the system, Xu Mu's focus shifted to the newly acquired ability "Touch of Obsession".As a time traveler who was born and raised in this world, he had heard many rumors about Transcendents and Sequencers before.Ordinary people only regard these anecdotes as after-dinner chats, and no one takes them seriously, but Xu Mu knows that those rumors may not be false, at least extraordinary people exist.Just like myself now!The touch of obsession, that's it... He secretly recited the name of the active extraordinary ability, and finally figured out the reason that induced the female corpse to "resurrection and give birth to a child".No wonder she couldn't be killed just now, but she died after giving birth to her "child". It turned out that giving birth to a child was her obsession.Although the stack of negative buffs on this ability is outrageous, it may have unexpected effects at critical moments.There is no need to kill the pregnant body. Will she die after giving birth?Xu Mu laughed dumbly: "Forget it, let's inform the library first." The entire monitoring process is recorded, and as long as it is reported truthfully, the library will handle it.Snap... snap.After stepping on sticky blood and walking out of the cold morgue, Xu Mu took out his cell phone and dialed the number of the funeral director Chen Sang.During the bell ringing, he relied on the extraordinary blessing of a clear mind to quickly organize his words so that his next speech would be more rigorous.After more than ten seconds, the call was connected, and a middle-aged man's voice came from the phone: "Xiao Xu, what's wrong?" Xu Mu's voice was deep: "Boss Chen, something unusual happened in your funeral home. I suggest you come over in person."
